title: Algorithmic Precision and Human Decision: A Study of Interactive Optimization for School Schedules
eligible_reason: No regression analysis at all: the package contains a Julia/JuMP school start-time optimization model, Python data standardization, benchmark comparisons with Bertsimas et al. (2019), and descriptive tallies of a 2022 parent/staff survey. regressions.txt is empty. No treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: Operations paper (SFUSD bell-time optimization). Figures 4-13 and 15 come from optimization runs and survey descriptives; Tables 1-2 are cost/schedule mappings. 'ft_staggered' flag is a false positive (staggered school start times).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: No staggered binary adoption in the reported designs.
data_files_note: Data are present but are optimization inputs and survey tallies, not a treatment-outcome panel.
software_notes: Julia (JuMP, Gurobi) and Python notebooks; no econometric software.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (ReadMe.md). Not an empirical DiD paper.
